import re

HEADER = re.compile(r"^Traceback \(most recent call last\):$")
CHAIN = re.compile(r"^(?:The above exception was the (?P<cause>direct cause) of the following exception|(?P<during>During handling) of the above exception, another exception occurred):$")
FRAME = re.compile(r"^\s{2}File \"(?P<file>[^\"]+)\", line (?P<line>\d+)(?:, in (?P<function>\S+))?\s*$")
CODE = re.compile(r"^\s{4}(?P<code>\S.*?)\s*$")
CARET = re.compile(r"^\s*[~^]+\s*$")
EXC = re.compile(r"^(?P<exception>\w[\w.]*)(?:: (?P<message>.*?))?\s*$")


def parse(lines):
    tbs, l_tb, frames, l_fr, skip = [], [], [], [], []
    tb, frame, link = None, None, ""
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        if HEADER.match(ln):
            tb = {"traceback": len(tbs) + 1, "exception": "", "message": "", "frames": 0,
                  "chained_from_previous": link}
            tbs.append(tb)
            l_tb.append(j)
            frame, link = None, ""
            continue
        m = CHAIN.match(ln)
        if m:
            link = (m.group("cause") or m.group("during")).lower()
            l_tb.append(j)
            continue
        if CARET.match(ln):
            skip.append(j)
            continue
        if tb is None:
            continue
        m = FRAME.match(ln)
        if m:
            tb["frames"] += 1
            frame = {"traceback": tb["traceback"], "frame": tb["frames"], "file": m.group("file"),
                     "line": m.group("line"), "function": m.group("function") or "", "code": ""}
            frames.append(frame)
            l_fr.append(j)
            continue
        m = CODE.match(ln)
        if m and frame is not None:
            frame["code"] = m.group("code")
            l_fr.append(j)
            continue
        m = EXC.match(ln)
        if m and not ln[0].isspace():
            tb["exception"], tb["message"] = m.group("exception"), m.group("message") or ""
            l_tb.append(j)
            frame = None
    return {"blocks": [{"name": "tracebacks", "kind": "table", "lines": l_tb, "records": tbs},
                       {"name": "frames", "kind": "table", "lines": l_fr, "records": frames}],
            "skip": skip}
